periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at a downward diagonal angle toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a length-to-width ratio greater than 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Tapered elongation extending from the orbital region toward the lower facial plane.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Band height at the lateral flank is roughly equivalent to the vertical span of the upper limb attachment.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distance between ears is approximately one head-width as measured across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular with a consistent convex curvature at the superior margin.
